items.title: En lukket mail-utveksling kan avsløre åpning: – Ikke noe offentlig ennå
items.excerpt: Gigantkjeden er allerede å se enkelte steder i Oslo. Nå kan KFC innta Oslo vest.

items.title: Kan bli store endringer på hva som avgjør prisen for å parkere i nabolaget ditt
items.excerpt: I Nordre Ake er det gratis, mens i Sagene må man ut med nesten 4000 kroner i året. Snart kan prisen på gateparkering bli bestemt langt nærmere deg enn i dag.

items.title: Løsnet skudd i Drammen – siktet for drapsforsøk
items.excerpt: Politiet har pågrepet tre unge menn i begynnelsen av 20-årene. Alle tre er nå siktet for drapsforsøk etter skytingen i Drammen.

items.title: 30 pågrepet i Økokrim-aksjon: – Alvorlig kriminalitet i et kriminelt nettverk
items.excerpt: Åtte politidistrikt har vært involvert i det Økokrim kaller alvorlig kriminalitet i fiskerinæringen. Politiet sier de har sikret verdier i 100-millionersklassen.

items.title: Further delays for major council overhaul in nine of 14 proposed areas
items.excerpt: Proposals to merge smaller councils to form larger unitary authorities were put on hold last month.

items.title: MP apologises over bullying and harassment
items.excerpt: Tony Vaughan is found to have been "overbearing and belittling" towards a female staff member.

items.title: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego among victims of deadly train collision
items.excerpt: Julieta Gallego, who competed for Madrid-based AD Sprint, among those killed in train crash in Spain.

items.title: Bereaved families will not face tax bill over pension delays under new rules
items.excerpt: Campaigners had warned some families could face an unfair financial penalty because of delays which were not their fault.

items.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
items.excerpt: The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan.

items.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
items.excerpt: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.
